resources.string: Use time, weekday, place, output route, completion, skips and recent taste together. All learning stays on this device.

Location is optional. Fresh fixes are requested only while the app is visible. Stale fixes are discarded; approximate mode groups coordinates into roughly 1 km regions. No background location permission is requested.
Location permission was not granted. Recommendations still work without it.
Record connected device names and audio capabilities. The active route is inferred from system routing; connected devices are stored separately.
Prediction error %1$.3f · fixed baseline %2$.3f (lower is better)

Learning uses explicit feedback and completion/early skips after starting a personal mix. Predictions are evaluated before learning. Sparse evidence is smoothed, and diverse artists and unexplored songs keep the mix from becoming repetitive. More data does not guarantee better predictions.
Feedback is saved on this device and included in your permanent music archive. “Less” excludes this song from personal mixes until reset.

Video is muted; your music keeps playing. Search results require your choice. YouTube uses its official player and is not downloaded. Imported video tracks use WebM for VP8/VP9 or MP4 for other supported codecs. A smaller compatible original may be retained instead.
No candidates found. Search on YouTube or add a link or file.
Video search is unavailable. You can still add a link or file.
Could not import this video. Check its codec, size (up to 1 GB) and available storage.
Video playback failed. Open video management to replace the link or file.
This release lacks a verifiable APK digest. Opening the release download in your browser.
APK verification failed. Size, checksum, package, version and signing certificate must match. Download again.
Installation did not start. Your verified APK is retained; tap Install to try again.
Updates verify the release SHA256, APK size, package, version and signing certificate. Cancelling the installer keeps the download for retry. Android installation approval is still required.
A compatible original was smaller than the remuxed video and was retained. Playback stays muted.
The video is taking too long to load. Check your connection and try again.
Cannot connect to YouTube. Check your connection and Android System WebView, then try again.
YouTube could not identify this player (153). Update Android System WebView and try again.
This video is unavailable or private. Choose another link.
The uploader does not allow embedded playback. Choose another video or open it on YouTube.
YouTube blocked automatic playback. Try again or choose a local video.
YouTube links are saved with NewPipeExtractor, up to 720p/30fps, video only. WebM is preferred; original audio keeps playing. Downloads wait for Wi-Fi by default. Each file is limited to 96 MB.
Waiting for Wi-Fi or saving video. You can keep listening while this runs in the background.
Could not save this video. Check your connection, free storage or choose another link. Private, restricted or unavailable videos cannot be saved.
Your original like and its history are preserved. Select the heart again to reaffirm your taste, or remove the like below. Ignoring this check-in is never treated as a dislike.
Keep original likes and history; ask again after you explicitly open an item.
Previous generations remain available. Votes belong to the exact list you saw.
Double-tap the centre to like. Double-tap either side to seek.
Low-rate motion summaries while playing or using the app. Transport is an estimate; ambiguous signals remain unknown. No raw sensor trace is stored.
Compatible experience settings checked. Native features still require an APK update.
Could not check experience updates. Your current settings are preserved.
Detailed examples are calculated while charging from up to 5,000 recent listening segments and actions for the month. Complete raw history and lifetime preferences remain preserved.
